description: Build a signed Open Graph (social card) image URL from a hosted template. By default returns the URL only and renders NOTHING — the image renders lazily the first time a social crawler fetches it, so agent/build time stays fast. Drop the URL into <meta property="og:image">. Pass render:true to also fetch a preview image now.

render.description: Also fetch and return a preview image now (default false: URL only).

name: og_image
